Thank you.   Politicians Must Stop Politicizing our Cities and States.  Elected officials must get back to basics and learn how to practice good state and city management.  Our cities must Stop setting up more NGO managed drug,  gang and nomadic/homeless by choice MAGNETS.  These programs draw ill and addicted people into the cities.  Our beleaguered cities are not equipped to deal with such volumes of ill and addicted people without affecting city budgets needed to fund basic city needs for the taxpayer who are paying the bills.  Immediate efforts should be focused on getting ill /addicted people to treatment and rehabilitation centers that are located outside of population centers.  Govenors and urban/rural center mayors should be taking the lead in identifying treatment/rehab centers that are located outside of our population centers.  It feels as if the master plan is to destroy historic communities to build soviet style communal housing and farming.  Urban and Rural non-nomadic residents are entitled to basic and competent services.  Why must stonewalled and left to deal with crime, graffiti, filth and continuous degradation of services.  When does it stop?

Homelessness isn’t compassion—it’s policy failure. For years, D.C. dumped billions into “harm reduction” and “housing first” scams that turned public spaces into open-air drug markets. The previous administration’s approach normalized chaos, enabling addiction and lawlessness while taxpayers footed the bill.

Trump’s EO pivots to accountability: enforce anti-camping laws, mandate treatment, and prioritize public safety. Medicaid fraud and illegal immigration compound the crisis—untracked usage by non-citizens strains resources meant for veterans and taxpayers.

Real solutions require order, not endless handouts. Cities shouldn’t be forced to choose between federal funds and sanity. This EO ends the era of subsidized decay.
